as_of_cutoff_rule: execution timestamp strictly less than outcome-known-at timestamp, and only outcome-known-at timestamps strictly earlier than the next execution; rows with adjudication known after the decision are not replay-trainable

as_of_reveal_diagnostics.note: Later adjudications are excluded from history before intervening execution points; history is only appended when known by the next decision time.

attempt_outcome_semantics.failed: execution/runtime or non-statistical safety/integrity failure, never coerced to predictive negative
attempt_outcome_semantics.inconclusive: executed but no binary adjudication, never coerced to either class
attempt_outcome_semantics.refused: pre-execution refusal, preserved outside executed config outcomes
attempt_outcome_semantics.rejected: criteria evaluation rejected; process-gate label only
attempt_outcome_semantics.success: ledger adjudication says criteria passed and recorded result ACCEPTED; process-gate success only
attempt_outcome_semantics.unverifiable: binary-looking adjudication without required linked spec/result artifact, not scored

candidate_identity: proposal direction as the reusable selection family; full experiment_config hash as the independent measurement group
decision_time: EXECUTED transition timestamp; history contains only previous group adjudications with known_at strictly before decision_time; simultaneous decisions are batched

execution_lifecycle_count_reconciliation.note: Per-attempt records are exact. Missing spec/result is an artifact-link dimension, not a new outcome label; missing-result attempts retain their ledger status and are excluded from binary prediction targets.

experimental_candidate_family_quality_un.reason: Historical gate pass/reject outcomes are not counterfactual candidate predictive quality. Only a small, policy-selected set of configurations was executed; candidate direction, execution time, numeric success thresholds, and proposal difficulty are confounded. No off-policy ranking comparison is estimable from the observed ledger.
experimental_candidate_family_quality_un.retention_decision: Keep the pooled prior as default; retain direction regularization and hybrid as quarantined development-only experiments, not a winning learner.

fixed_chronological_second_half.split_definition: boundary is the execution-time median over all executed attempts (including those excluded from binary scoring); target config predictions on/after it are reported as chronological later-period outcomes

fixed_first_time_second_half.assignment: predictions at or after fixed median execution-time boundary; used descriptively, without outcome-based boundary choice

limitations: Acceptance/adjudication is a process-gate target, not candidate predictive quality or market performance.
Only one short campaign month and two W-SUN weeks are represented; chronological CIs are weak.
The realized policy chose which proposals were executed; rejected/unselected alternatives have no observed counterfactual outcomes, so off-policy utility cannot be identified.

The logged primary metric is success under variable statistical/gating criteria, not market predictive quality. First full-config grouping leaves 66 groups but many have only one point; scientific treatment-equivalent config collapsing leaves only about a dozen groups and mixes repeated trials with time-varying exposure, so neither gives a causal policy comparison.

The direction-level learner cannot estimate candidate quality: direction labels pool heterogeneous arms, estimators, thresholds, seed sets, and campaign phases; the apparent high pass rate in later days is confounded by changing direction mix and rising global prevalence.
Direction is strongly confounded with proposal difficulty, criteria, generation policy, and campaign batch.
Missing result artifacts are labeled unverifiable and excluded from binary scores; failed runs and pre-execution refusals are not false candidate labels.

methods.calibrated_pooled_beta: Beta(1,1) pooled group pass-rate; no learned candidate preference.
methods.conservative_hybrid: pooled Beta baseline until 12 prior independent groups within the candidate direction, then linearly blend through 30; thresholds fixed before replay, not optimized here.
methods.regularized_direction_beta: Beta(4) candidate-family preference, pooled 25% toward the direction rate and 75% global rate; equal-weight config votes.
methods.ucb_acquisition: regularized mean + 0.25 posterior SD with a 3-to-12-group warm-up, clipped at 1; ranking-only, not a calibrated probability.

scoring_target: first fully linked binary adjudication (ACCEPTED/criteria-passed success vs criteria rejection) per exact full experiment_config; not market AUC, return, or profitability

target_identity_diagnostics.warning: The scored outcome is gate/adjudication success, while configurations vary in treatment and numeric success criteria. Exact full-config grouping avoids mixing gate specifications but creates pseudo-diversity; collapsing to model treatment yields too few groups and still leaves criterion-dependent labels. Neither validates candidate market quality.
